basics.name: Woorim Shin
basics.label: Computer Science undergraduate — AI systems and Korean language technology
basics.summary: Computer science undergraduate working on AI systems: Korean speech recognition in production, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, and energy attribution for AI workloads on shared hardware. I like problems where a model meets the machine it runs on.

work.name: Ewha DAIA Lab
highlights: LLM agent memory reliability: treating agent degradation as a state-update failure, and building a versioned memory store that propagates invalidation to dependent memories, evaluated on two public benchmarks.

work.name: Hiconsy
highlights: Led the AI/ML R&D function at Hiconsy, the parent company of the Sidae Injae CSAT academy, directing research strategy and coordinating a cross-functional team.
Architected and deployed a production Korean lecture ASR system end to end.
Established QA workflows by building custom annotation tools for non-technical QC staff.

work.name: SDIJ Forest Team
work.position: Project Lead and Sole Developer (4-person team)
highlights: Initiated Korean CSAT education planning projects and expanded into technical development where product strategy required it.
Engineered a learning analytics automation pipeline (Selenium, Google APIs) that replaced manual workflows and cut repetitive work by about 80%.
Built a large-scale NLP pipeline over educational forum data to automate student sentiment analysis and surface concerns early.
